Hi everyone, I'm back with this curious furry comic that I found by chance on the web. Since it's quite old-school and quick to do, I decided to get to work on it.

I am also attaching the clean version of the comic for anyone who wants to handle translating it into other languages.

For those who want to know more or download the English version: https://ookamithewolf1.itch.io/fanny-fennec-issue-1
